source_gap_claims.behavior: Do not require a database or backup system when a package declares no database capability.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require database infrastructure for declared database capabilities but do not state the no-capability exemption.
source_gap_claims.subject: Database capability declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a subprocess capability declaration that omits its cancellation/process-tree owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require each declaration to identify that owner, but do not require validation to fail when it is absent.
source_gap_claims.subject: Subprocess capability validation
